title: ajaxUpdatePaginationLinks
description: Admin table pagination/filter AJAX request from view_updater_pagination.js to ViewUpdater.php

part.description: Optional progressive response part; omitted requests retain the legacy all-in-one response

rowsPerPage.description: Sent as string from JS, parsed via absint()

sessionId.description: Immutable request ledger: joins retried requests from the same browser tab/session.

retryParentId.description: Immutable request ledger: requestId of the attempt this retry is following up on.

clientSentAt.description: Immutable request ledger: client-side send timestamp, for boot-delta/queueing diagnostics.
